method: Hand-verifying the two esbuild suppressions produced by re-running npm-reachability-triage over the 9 projects the pnpm reader and repository walk made readable but nobody had hand-verified found that the matched advisory carries a withdrawn field OSV publishes but advisory_from_osv did not read. Re-running run_portfolio_sample.py against the fix over the original 7-product npm sample surfaced two more withdrawn records the same way. This file records all three, each read directly from the OSV npm feed used for this pass.

withdrawn_advisories_matched_in_this_por.summary: Withdrawn Advisory: esbuild: Missing binary integrity verification in Deno module enables remote code execution via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY
withdrawn_advisories_matched_in_this_por.why_withdrawn: misattributed to the wrong ecosystem (the real affected package is a Deno-only module, not npm esbuild)

withdrawn_advisories_matched_in_this_por.summary: Duplicate Advisory: Wrangler affected by OS Command Injection in `wrangler pages deploy`
withdrawn_advisories_matched_in_this_por.why_withdrawn: withdrawn as a duplicate of another advisory

withdrawn_advisories_matched_in_this_por.summary: Withdrawn Advisory: eslint has a Stack Overflow when serializing objects with circular references

effect_on_the_2026-08-21_hand_verified_s.note: Every removed claim had been reasoned correctly by the suppression rule (dependency-path: dev-only in every location) -- ACCURACY_WRONG_CLAIMS stays 0. The 2 shipped-verdict instances (ai-first-markets: 2, local-site-studio: 1, both esbuild/GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr; ai-first-markets also had the wrangler/GHSA-8h3q-9fpp-c883 one shipped) were never covered by the wrong-suppression methodology at all, since that measures suppressed findings only -- this is the first check of whether an unsuppressed (shipped) finding is itself real.

effect_on_the_9_newly_readable_projects.note: The 2 pre-fix findings were both GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr on retail-pilot-intel/apps/docs and apps/portal.
